title: Release Notify Config (release-notify/v2)
description: XACA-1399 / EPIC-0068 D2. v2 adds notice-type routing to the team's notify.json. v1 stays a separate, UNCHANGED schema (notify.schema.json); release_config_validate dispatches on '$schema'. Cross-checks the schema cannot express (route/severityOverrides ids must exist in the merged notice-type catalog, quietHours start != end, timezone is a real IANA zone) run in kanban-hooks/release_notify_routing.py.

aliases.description: Optional in v2. Same alias grammar and secretRef rules as v1 (direct-provider aliases; also the XACA-1403 local-fallback set).

shape.description: teams provider only -- payload shape ('flow' default, or 'webhook'). Ignored by other providers.

target.description: Never a literal destination (URL/number) -- always a secretRef (§ 2.2, § 11.4).

secretRef.description: vault:<engine_slug>/<account_slug> or env:RELEASE_<TEAM>_<PURPOSE> only. A literal value is a validation error.

routes.description: notice-type id -> hub connection ids (connections live in Fleet Monitor, EPIC-0068 D2). An empty list is an explicit 'route nowhere'.

severityOverrides.description: Optional per-type severity; wins over the catalog defaultSeverity.

quietHours.description: Suppress notices below 'critical' inside [start,end) in the given zone; the window may span midnight. critical always bypasses.

dedupeWindow.description: Seconds. Same team+type+ref inside the window collapses to one notice. 0 disables. Absent = 300 (release_notify_routing.DEFAULT_DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECONDS).
